card.name: Turning bad into good
card.fires_on: Verbs of turning or converting (turn, converting, transform, make the best out of) and words right after them, where a negative thing is about to be changed into something positive.

modes.label: Turn/convert verbs
modes.description: The verb turn, convert or transform, expecting a bad thing as the object.
modes.example: Together we can<< turn>> this ship around and get on course.

modes.label: Word after the verb
modes.description: A small word following the turning verb, before the problem or hardship is named.
modes.example: this project is simply converting<< the>> problem into a solution

modes.label: Making the best of hardship
modes.description: Phrases about coping with or making good out of bad situations.
modes.example: make the best out<< of>> bad situations."

card.writes: It promotes words for loss, failure, crisis and disadvantage, and suppresses words for success and happiness, so it predicts a negative thing as the object being turned.
card.plain: It fires on phrases about turning or converting a problem into something better, where a bad thing is about to be named.
evidence: make the best out<< of>> bad situations."
